abstract: Although in recent years the evidence of an increase in serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme-1 (LDH-1) in patients with germ cell tumor (GCT) has attracted attention, there have only been a few reports concerning yolk sac tumor (YST), which is a frequent type of GCT in childhood. Serum LDH isoenzymes were determined in eight children with YST, and an increase in LDH-1 was found in seven of them, excluding one in an early stage. On the basis of the findings of serial serum LDH-1 levels during treatment and of LDH isoenzyme pattern in tumor tissues, it is presumed that the increased serum LDH-1 is derived from tumor tissues. LDH-1 seems to be useful as a tumor marker, not specific for YST but associated with the whole spectrum of GCT, for monitoring of YST.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）患者における血清LDH-1の上昇が近年注目されているが、卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）に関する報告は少ない。YSTは小児に多い胚細胞腫瘍の一型である。卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児8例について血清LDHアイソザイムを測定したところ、早期の1例を除く7例でLDH-1の上昇が認められた。治療中の血清LDH-1の連続測定と腫瘍組織のLDHアイソザイムパターンから、増加した血清LDH-1は腫瘍組織に由来すると推定された。LDH-1はYSTに特異的ではないが、GCT全体に関連する腫瘍マーカーとして、YSTの経過観察に有用と考えられる。
